about_the_game:
Here is to the brave warriors who never relent! Push your limits and let us hear your victory roar! Introducing the first-ever LES MILLS XR BODYCOMBAT DLC: Power Strike!

KEY FEATURES

🕹️ New game mechanics!

Power Strike: punch it your hardest and get bonus points!

New Final Targets: feel the energy of your last punch with the explosion of this target at the end of each workout!

💪 New workouts

New exclusive workouts and new songs! You will have to be courageous to meet this challenge!

🦁 New premium environment

The Arena of the Brave is an ode to those warriors who keep fighting to achieve their fitness goals. Experience the new open dojo with impressive mighty golden lions!

✨ Exclusive premium cosmetics

Shine like never before with golden gloves and a luxurious new platform for your feet. New and exclusive cosmetics for your epic workouts!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 Sandy Bridge or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • VR Support: SteamVR. Standing or Room Scale
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590 equivalent or greater
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
